capabilities: Render sfb-figlet code blocks as styled ASCII art
Insert ASCII art through a command palette dialog with preview
Style output with fonts, colors, gradients, size, opacity and alignment
Fill {{frontmatter:key}} placeholders in figlet text from note frontmatter
Expose a window.figletAPI for other plugins to generate ASCII art
extras: Pending Obsidian community plugin review; currently installable via BRAT or manually. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. About 1.5 MB of main.js is gzipped embedded font data. Notes limitations: large text renders slowly and some fonts lack characters.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render decorative ASCII art text from Figlet fonts inside notes.

relations.evidence: You can install this plugin right now using the BRAT plugin
reads each font listed in src/font-list.json from the figlet package's fonts/ folder

summary: Figlet code block renderer that turns note text into ASCII art banners using 326 bundled fonts, colors, gradients, sizing, and an insert dialog.
